integration.name: Twilio
integration.summary: The largest CPaaS by reach, and the most mature US long-code, short-code and A2P ecosystem. If you already run on Twilio, connecting it here changes nothing about your account or your bill.

credentials.label: Auth Token
credentials.note: The account-level token, not an API key pair.

config.label: Sender numbers
config.note: One or more Twilio numbers or Messaging Service senders.

strengths: Widest country coverage of any provider we integrate
Mature US long-code / short-code / A2P registration paths
Same account, same console, same invoice — we never sit in between
considerations: Our default pacing starts at 1 message/second per connection. Your real quota depends on your Twilio account tier and number type, so raise it in the console once you know it.
Twilio rate-limits per sending number, not per account. If you bind several numbers to one connection, raise the pacing accordingly.
